page.layout: One page of text: running head and page number at the top; Greek paragraph-like tables of participle forms in the main column, with headings in italic; marginal catchwords/labels at the right margin beside each group.
page.notes: Greek forms are transcribed as printed, with the printer's abbreviated endings (ϛ for -ος, τẽ for τῷ). The right-margin labels Præsens, Perfectũ, Infinitũ 1/2 and Futurũ 1/2 are side notes. The page number reads "111" in the scan but may be "M1" (possibly 111); treated as printed. The running head is taken from the top line, with "PARTICIPIVM." as a second line. Some Greek accents and breathings are uncertain and may need checking [?].
